rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a person, personality, or thing that is exceptionally attractive or charming.

example.english: They find him so magnetic that everyone gathers around to listen.
example.traditional: 佢講嘢咁有吸引力，成班人都圍住佢聽。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 gam3 jau5 kap1 jan5 lik6 sing4 baan1 jan4 dou1 wai4 zyu6 keoi5 teng1

rows.note: Use 磁性 for the general physical sense of involving magnetism or having the properties of a magnet, rather than for personal charm or magnetic north.

example.english: This magnet is highly magnetic, so the iron nails stick to it.
example.traditional: 呢塊磁石磁性好強，一掂到啲鐵釘就黐埋去。
example.jyutping: ne1 faai3 ci4 sek6 ci4 sing3 hou3 koeng4 jat1 dim3 dou3 di1 tit3 deng1 zau6 ci1 maai4 heoi3

rows.note: Use 磁北 specifically for the compass direction called magnetic north.

example.english: When using a compass, remember that magnetic north and true north are not exactly the same.
example.traditional: 用指南針睇方向，要記住磁北同真北唔係完全一樣。
example.jyutping: jung6 zi2 naam4 zam1 tai2 fong1 hoeng3 jiu3 gei3 zyu6 ci4 bak1 tung4 zan1 bak1 m4 hai6 jyun4 cyun4 jat1 joeng6
